steps.title: Read zone signage
steps.instruction: Read required PPE posted at the zone entrance.

steps.title: Don hard hat
steps.instruction: Put on hard hat with chin strap secured.

steps.title: Don high-visibility vest
steps.instruction: Put on hi-vis vest. Mark the zone entry line on the floor.
steps.hint: Vest must be visible from the front and back.

placement.prompt: Place the ring on the floor at the zone boundary beside the real line or tape.

steps.title: Enter zone
steps.instruction: Cross the entry line only when all PPE is on.
